main.description: Lists a community's channels as a flat list, for clients that do not need the category grouping.

community.description: The community to list channels of.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The requesting user lacks permission to view this community's channels.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists with that DID.
